knowledge.title: Book of Will
knowledge.tooltipBody: Will is your stock of Power. Actions cost Will.
knowledge.tooltipRefillPost: refills it, so do not waste it.
knowledge.meterHint:
Answer questions correctly to
gain Will and reach milestones.
knowledge.hallLore: Knowledge is the wellspring of Will. Here you earn the Will that lets you travel the whole world — every step beyond camp and every deed draws on it. Answer true and swift: the sharper the mind, the stronger the Will.
knowledge.full: Your Will is stronger than ever! Time to set out on an adventure.
knowledge.wrong: Incorrect. Try to remember the correct answer.

knowledge.rejected: Action not completed. Check your answer and the current challenge state.

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
woodcutter.desc: The camp needs timber. Cut trees in the wild.
woodcutter.how:
Put an axe in your hand.
Use it on trees in the wild to cut them.
Cut 10 trees.
Walk back to the quest board and press Claim.
woodcutter.rule: Free to take. Needs an axe in your hand. Every cut costs {will} Will and wears the axe. Only trees you cut count.

stonebreaker.name: Stonebreaker
stonebreaker.desc: Break stone for the camp walls.
stonebreaker.how:
Put a pickaxe in your hand.
Use it on rocks to mine them.
Mine 8 stones.
Walk back to the quest board and press Claim.
stonebreaker.rule: Free to take. Needs a pickaxe in your hand. Every mining costs {will} Will and wears the pickaxe. Only stones you mine count.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.desc: Sharpen your mind in the Book of Will.
scholar.how:
Open the Book of Will in the camp.
Answer the questions.
Give 15 correct answers.
Walk to the quest board and press Claim.
scholar.rule: Free to take. Only correct answers in the Book of Will count; a wrong answer adds nothing. Each correct answer also gives you Will.

bone-hunter.name: Bone Hunter
bone-hunter.desc: The crypt is full of walking bones. Thin them out.
bone-hunter.table: Defeat 3 skeletons in battles, get a wooden shield.
bone-hunter.how:
Take a sword in your hand.
Attack skeleton squads in the crypt.
Win battles until 3 skeletons fall.
Walk back to the quest board and press Claim.
bone-hunter.rule: Costs {entry} Will to take. Only skeletons you defeat in a battle you win count; a lost battle adds nothing.

seeker-1.name: First Trail
seeker-1.desc: Follow the numbers through the fog to the chest.
seeker-1.table: Find the chest at the end of the trail.
seeker-1.how:
Press Enter on the card.
Step to the hex whose number continues the pattern.
Keep every step paid with Will.
Open the chest at the end and take the loot, then return to camp.
seeker-1.rule: Entry costs {entry} Will. Every step costs {step} Will, a step back costs {back}. The trail is {steps} steps long. Only the real chest ends the quest.

seeker-2.name: Leaping Trail
seeker-2.desc: The numbers jump. Find the pattern.
seeker-2.table: Find the chest at the end of the trail.
seeker-2.how:
Press Enter on the card.
The numbers jump: find the rule before you step.
Keep every step paid with Will.
Open the chest at the end and take the loot, then return to camp.
seeker-2.rule: Entry costs {entry} Will. Every step costs {step} Will, a step back costs {back}. The trail is {steps} steps long. The First Trail must be finished first.

seeker-3.name: Cunning Trail
seeker-3.desc: Every step costs more. Choose carefully.
seeker-3.table: Find the chest at the end of the trail.
seeker-3.how:
Press Enter on the card.
Every step costs more, so plan the path.
A wrong hex can be left with a step back.
Open the chest at the end and take the loot, then return to camp.
seeker-3.rule: Entry costs {entry} Will. Every step costs {step} Will, a step back costs {back}. The trail is {steps} steps long. The Leaping Trail must be finished first.
